question_cn: 你有时候会感到无聊吗？
answer_cn: 是的，有时候会。我通常在没事做的时候感到无聊。这时候我会出去散散步，听听音乐。这能让我放松下来。
answer_en: Yes sometimes. I usually feel bored when I have nothing to do. Then I go for a walk and listen to some music. It helps me relax.

question_en: What do you do in your free time?
answer_cn: 空闲时间我喜欢看视频、听音乐。有时候我也会和朋友一起打羽毛球。这能让我放松，也能让我保持健康。

question_en: Do you prefer hot weather or cold weather?
question_cn: 你更喜欢热天还是冷天？
answer_cn: 我更喜欢冷天。热天出汗很多，让人很不舒服。冷天我可以穿厚衣服，喝一杯热茶。
answer_en: I prefer cold weather. In hot weather I sweat a lot and it feels uncomfortable. In cold weather I can wear warm clothes and drink a cup of hot tea.
